stem:
The graph shows how many books a class returned on four days.

Which conclusion is justified by the graph?

options.text: Tuesday has the tallest bar, so more books were returned on Tuesday than on any other labelled day.
The vertical axis is labelled Books, so the answer is the word Books.
Wednesday shows about $8$ books even though the scale marks are every $5$ books.
Books cause Tuesday to be busier than Monday.

teacher.key_rationale: Read categories and bar heights first: Tuesday’s bar is tallest among Mon–Thu. Naming the axis word alone, ignoring the scale marks, or reversing to a causal claim all go beyond what the graph shows.
teacher.figure_note: Column graph of books returned Mon–Thu; learner compares bar heights.
